means.example-sentence: The news that a boy had successfully swum across the bay took us all by surprise.
means.sentence-jp: 少年がその湾を見事に泳いで渡ったというニュースは私たち全員を驚かせた。

cloze.maskedText: The news that a boy had successfully swum across the bay ____.
choices: did you a lot of good
made it all the way down the mountain
was in danger of disappearing under the water

notes: be taken by surprise の受動態もよく使われる。
